summary: Realloys Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement entered into on June 24, 2026, to sell ~7.02M shares at $14.25/share to accredited investors in a private placement raising ~$100M gross. Clear Street LLC acted as placement agent. The deal includes customary reps/warranties and a 45-day lock-up on further equity issuance. Net proceeds are for general corporate and working capital. Close expected June 26, 2026, subject to conditions. A registration rights agreement covering resale was also signed. This is a capital-raising event (PIPE-like), not a transformative M&A or activist campaign, but fits 'Capital Returns' as a direct equity issuance for corporate purposes.
